personaSeed: You are a developer in a hurry between meetings. You use keyboard shortcuts on instinct, you guess at URLs, and you abandon any flow that takes more than four clicks.

findings.summary: The 'Promote to build' step — the pipeline's own path from a locked brief to builder tasks — fails every time: the proposal preview request returns HTTP 500, the modal shows a raw '500 Internal Server Error' with no retry guidance, and 'Confirm and compile' stays disabled. Three attempts over several minutes all failed the same way.

Submitting discovery answers frequently returns HTTP 400 while the form still shows 'Ready to send.' with no visible error; a page reload then wipes all selected answers, forcing the user to re-answer the same questions multiple times (I re-did round 1 three times and round 2 twice).

Discovery's follow-up question rounds never appear live: after submitting a round, the page keeps saying 'Discovery is still running' and the error banner names questions ('When a short link is visited, which matters more?' etc.) that are nowhere on the page — only a manual browser reload reveals the new round.

On the home page, the Start button still reads as disabled after typing a prompt and picking 'API service'; clicking it appears to do nothing, yet a project is silently created and the page navigates a moment later, which reads as a broken button to a first-time user.

Workaround that achieved the goal: creating a Board task assigned to the Developer triggered an automatic system delegation ('You have been assigned as lead to: Build the URL shortener REST API with rate limiting (per locked brief)') visible in the Inbox, so the locked brief was handed to a builder despite the broken promote path; the task itself remains in 'Not Started'.
